test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The pyramids that you see in Egypt were built by the Pharoh dynasties who ruled the ancient kingdom of Egypt for thousands of years.
solution:
The correct answer is **Pharaoh.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The correct word is ***PHARAOH ***which means the head of state and religious leaders of ancient Egypt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at meaning of the other words:

 
• **Pyramids:** a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.
 
• **Dynasties: **a line of hereditary rulers of a country.
 
• **Ancient:** belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.
